lines.zh: 我小跑着追你的脚后跟
lines.en: I trot after your heels.
My legs are short, so my steps come fast.
I stumble, then scramble up.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀太小，还飞不高
lines.en: My wings are too small to lift me far.
I go around your boot.
I trot along with my tail up.
I look up for you and nearly hit a tree.
I am a little out of breath keeping up.
I push through the grass.
I stepped on my own tail.

lines.zh: 我跑到你前面，又退回来
lines.en: I run ahead, then back.
I slip on a stone.
I stop at the edge of your shadow.
I sit at your feet.
I chase my own tail.
My scales are not hard yet.

lines.zh: 我抬头看你，等你说什么
lines.en: I look up, waiting for you to say something.
I give a small yawn.

lines.zh: 我把头搁在你的靴子上
lines.en: I rest my head on your boot.

lines.zh: 我听见鸟叫，头就转过去
lines.en: A bird calls and my head turns.
I flutter my small wings.
I am not sleepy, and not ready to move.
I am sniffing your pocket.
My tail taps the ground.
My wings have just opened.
I am waiting for you to pat my head.
You have to look down to see me.
I hold my head up, and my neck aches.

lines.zh: 我这么小，你会不会嫌我
lines.en: I am small; will you mind?
I know your scent.
Wherever you go, take me.
I bounce on the spot.
What is in your hand?
I have not grown big yet.
Will you keep me always?
I stand between your feet.
I rub against your boot.
I huddle by the nest and watch you.
I am waiting for you to crouch.
I roll over in front of you.
I cry out in pain.
I lie flat on the ground.
One of my scales came off.
I get up slowly.
That really did hurt.
I hide behind you.
I hold my wings tight.
I am still lying here.
I grit my teeth and do not cry.
I push my snout over and sniff.
I am small, do not give me too much.
Hold it lower, please.
I take a small bite.
I cannot really bite through this.
I get it all over my face.
I want more after this.
Do not take your hand away yet.
I knock it to the ground.
You stepped on my tail.
I get bounced back a short way.
I am small; watch your feet.
You pinned my wing down.
I puff through my nostrils.
I wobble back onto my feet.
Slow down and wait for me.

lines.zh: 翅膀还小，撞一下会歪着飞。
lines.en: My wings are still small; one bump and I'll fly crooked.
I am still this small.
I do not understand any of that.
You are the only one I have.
I cock my head and look at you.
I go back to my tail.
Stop asking me that.
I lie down on the ground to rest.
I can hardly keep my eyes open.
I shut my eyes.
I pick it up and run to you.
I hold it in both claws.
It is bigger than my head.
I left a tooth mark in it.
I put it at your feet.
I nearly swallowed it.
I nudge it with a small claw.
I pick it up again.
I carry it over to show you.
The little spikes on my neck rise.
I stand in front of your feet.
I spread my little wings.
I try a growl.
I flatten down against the ground.
It is much bigger than me.
I refuse to give a step.
I plant myself in front of your feet.
Do not be nervous for me.
I have set my stance.
This time I charge first.
It should not have come this way.
I growl louder now.
I stay in the middle.
My legs shake, but I hold.
I want you behind me.
The tip of my tail is pulled straight.
I edge one small step forward.
It is two heads taller than me.
I will not step aside.
I will keep you behind me.
I growl a second time.
I crouch to spring.
A little further.
I am still ahead of you.
I will not dodge this time.
I duck low and leap at it.
I bite its leg.
I am too small; it barely felt it.
I shake my head twice.
It knocks me over.
I push up on my legs again.
My claws rake once.
That took all my strength.
I am too winded to speak.
Do not come this way.
I stand in front of you.
My two legs feel a bit weak.
I crawl out of the shell.
Slime still clings to my scales.
I see light for the first time.
I am a little taller than your boot.
I raise my head and find you.
I try out my wings.
I take two steps and fall.
My first call is very thin.

lines.zh: 我挪着小碎步到你脚边
lines.en: I shuffle over to your feet in tiny steps.
I kick the shell apart.

lines.zh: 我的爪子踩在地上很软
lines.en: The ground feels soft under my claws.
I shake the slime off.
I catch your scent.
I take a step and look at you.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴还不太听使唤
lines.en: My tail does not quite obey me.
I circle twice by your boot.
I want to follow, but my legs are short.
I tumble down the steps.
Water reaches my nose.
The blast throws me into the grass.

lines.zh: 一支箭擦过我的小翅膀
lines.en: An arrow grazes my small wing.
Magic leaves me numb all over.
Hunger makes me whimper.

lines.zh: 雷打得很近，我钻到你身后
lines.en: Lightning strikes close and I dive behind you.
The ground under my feet is gone.
